articles.title: AI and Human Both Claim to Solve Riemann Hypothesis
articles.titleZh: 人工智能与人类都声称解决黎曼猜想
articles.summaryZh: 数学家们惊讶于AI的最新成果，也有竞争性的人类解答。

sentences.en: Scientists are stunned by a new AI system that claims to solve the 167‑year‑old Riemann hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 科学家们对一套新的人工智能系统声称解决了已有167年的黎曼猜想感到震惊。

focus.text: stunned by a new AI system
focus.meaning: 被新的人工智能系统震惊
解决已有167年的黎曼猜想

sentences.en: The algorithm, developed by researchers at a leading university, uses deep learning to analyze complex number patterns.
sentences.zh: 该算法由一家顶尖大学的研究人员开发，利用深度学习分析复杂数值模式。

sentences.en: At the same time, a mathematician named Dr. Li has published a paper outlining a traditional proof of the hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一位名叫李博士的数学家发表了一篇论文，提出了传统的黎曼猜想证明。

sentences.en: Both claims have been reviewed by peer experts, who say the AI’s result is promising but still unverified.
sentences.zh: 两项主张都已被同行专家审查，专家表示AI的结果有前景，但仍未得到验证。

sentences.en: The mathematician’s proof, meanwhile, follows classical methods and has passed initial scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，数学家的证明遵循经典方法，并已通过初步审查。

sentences.en: The Riemann hypothesis, which predicts patterns in prime numbers, has been a central challenge in mathematics for over a century.
sentences.zh: 黎曼猜想预测质数的模式，已成为数学中心挑战超过一百年。

sentences.en: If either solution is confirmed, it could reshape number theory and impact cryptography, which relies on prime numbers.
sentences.zh: 如果任何一项解决方案得到确认，可能会重塑数论，并影响依赖质数的密码学。

sentences.en: Researchers will continue testing both approaches, and the mathematical community eagerly awaits a definitive verdict.
sentences.zh: 研究人员将继续测试两种方法，数学界热切期待最终判决。

sentences.en: Stay tuned as updates come from top journals and conferences in the coming months.
sentences.zh: 请关注未来几个月顶级期刊和会议的最新动态。

quiz.q: What is the main claim made by the AI system?
options: It discovered a new prime number
It solved the P versus NP problem

quiz.q: Which field would be most affected if the Riemann hypothesis is proven?
quiz.explainZh: 黎曼猜想与质数相关，影响密码学。

articles.title: Signal Blocks Screenshots to Fight AI Surveillance Threat
articles.titleZh: Signal屏蔽截图以应对AI监控威胁
articles.summaryZh: Signal限制安卓和iOS用户截图功能，旨在抵御人工智能监控的存在性威胁。

sentences.en: Signal, the secure messaging app, has announced it will block screenshots on both Android and iOS devices.
sentences.zh: Signal这款安全通讯应用宣布将在安卓和iOS设备上阻止截图功能。

focus.note: 常用来描述禁止拍照或截屏的功能

sentences.en: The move comes after concerns that AI could analyze captured images and reconstruct private conversations.
sentences.zh: 此举是在担忧AI可能分析捕获的图像并重建私人对话后提出的。

focus.note: 描述人工智能的分析能力

sentences.en: Signal’s policy update will affect all users, regardless of their device or operating system.
sentences.zh: Signal的政策更新将影响所有用户，无论他们使用哪种设备或操作系统。

sentences.en: The company says the restriction is temporary, aimed at protecting user privacy until a better solution is found.
sentences.zh: 公司表示此限制是临时的，旨在保护用户隐私，直至找到更好的解决方案。

sentences.en: Signal’s CEO, Brian Acton, said the decision reflects the company’s commitment to secure communication.
sentences.zh: Signal的CEO布莱恩·阿克顿表示，此决定体现了公司对安全通讯的承诺。

sentences.en: The restriction will be rolled out in the next app update, expected in the coming weeks.
sentences.zh: 此限制将在即将发布的下一次应用更新中推出，预计在未来几周内。

sentences.en: Users can still share text, audio, and video messages, but not screenshots of the conversation.
sentences.zh: 用户仍可分享文本、音频和视频信息，但不能截图对话。

focus.text: share text, audio, and video messages
focus.meaning: 分享文本、音频和视频信息

sentences.en: Privacy advocates welcome the move, citing the growing threat of AI-powered surveillance.
sentences.zh: 隐私倡导者欢迎此举，指出AI驱动的监控威胁日益增长。

sentences.en: Signal users should check the app’s settings to understand how the new restriction will affect their conversations.
sentences.zh: Signal用户应检查应用设置，以了解新限制如何影响他们的对话。

sentences.en: The company will monitor the impact and may lift the restriction if it proves ineffective.
sentences.zh: 公司将监测影响，并可能在无效时解除限制。

quiz.q: Why has Signal decided to block screenshots?
quiz.explainZh: Signal 之所以阻止截图，是为了抵御 AI 监控的存在性威胁。

quiz.q: Which devices will be affected by the screenshot restriction?
quiz.explainZh: 此限制将影响安卓和 iOS 两种设备的所有用户。

articles.title: Draft Deal Seeks to Save COP31 Negotiations
articles.summaryZh: 联合国COP31会议在土耳其进入第二天加班，国家间难以达成协议。

sentences.en: The COP31 climate summit in Turkey has entered a second day of overtime negotiations.
sentences.zh: 土耳其的COP31气候峰会已进入第二天的加班谈判。

focus.note: 用于描述会议延长时间

sentences.en: Countries are struggling to agree on a new draft deal that could prevent the talks from collapsing.
sentences.zh: 各国正努力就一项新的草案达成一致，以防谈判崩溃。

sentences.en: The draft includes stronger emissions targets and clearer timelines for implementation.
sentences.zh: 该草案包含更严格的减排目标和更清晰的实施时间表。

sentences.en: It also calls for increased financial support for developing countries to adapt to climate change.
sentences.zh: 它还呼吁为发展中国家适应气候变化提供更多财政支持。

focus.meaning: 为发展中国家提供财政支持

sentences.en: The United Nations Secretary‑General has urged all parties to keep the summit on track.
sentences.zh: 联合国秘书长敦促所有各方保持峰会进度。

sentences.en: If the draft is accepted, it could set a precedent for future climate agreements.
sentences.zh: 如果草案被接受，它可能为未来的气候协议树立先例。

focus.note: 常用于法律和政策讨论

sentences.en: Opponents argue the deal lacks enforceable mechanisms and may delay action.
sentences.zh: 反对者认为该协议缺乏可执行机制，可能延迟行动。

sentences.en: World leaders will decide by the end of the week whether to adopt the proposal.
sentences.zh: 世界领导人将在本周末决定是否采纳该提案。

focus.text: by the end of the week

sentences.en: The outcome will influence global climate policy and the next UN climate conference.
sentences.zh: 结果将影响全球气候政策和下一届联合国气候会议。

sentences.en: Stay tuned for updates as the summit moves toward a final agreement.
sentences.zh: 请关注更新，随着峰会向最终协议推进。

quiz.q: What is the main purpose of the new draft deal discussed at COP31?
options: To increase financial aid for developed countries
To prevent the collapse of negotiations
quiz.explainZh: 该草案旨在防止谈判崩溃。

quiz.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as part of the draft deal?
quiz.explainZh: 文中未提到可执行机制是草案的一部分。

articles.title: Russia-bound Ship Attacked in Gulf of Finland
articles.titleZh: 俄罗斯船只在芬兰湾遭遇袭击
articles.summaryZh: 一艘驶往俄罗斯的船只在芬兰湾被无人机攻击，芬兰防卫部队怀疑乌克兰负责。

sentences.en: A cargo ship heading to Russia was struck by a drone in the Gulf of Finland yesterday.
sentences.zh: 一艘驶往俄罗斯的货船在昨天的芬兰湾被无人机击中。

focus.note: 常用于描述运输货物的船只

sentences.en: Finnish defence forces say the attack was likely carried out by Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 芬兰防卫部队表示，这次袭击很可能是乌克兰实施的。

focus.note: 用来表达推测的可能性

sentences.en: The vessel was en route to a Russian port when the drone struck its side.
sentences.zh: 船只正驶向俄罗斯港口时，被无人机击中侧面。

sentences.en: No crew members were injured, and the ship continued its journey after emergency repairs.
sentences.zh: 船员未受伤，船只在紧急修理后继续航行。

sentences.en: The incident highlights the growing risk of drone attacks on commercial shipping in the Baltic Sea.
sentences.zh: 此事件凸显了波罗的海地区商业航运面临的无人机袭击风险。

sentences.en: Finnish authorities are investigating the attack and monitoring nearby maritime traffic closely.
sentences.zh: 芬兰当局正在调查此袭击，并密切监视附近海上交通。

sentences.en: Russia has not yet responded to the incident, but it may affect future shipping routes to the country.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯尚未对此作出回应，但这可能影响未来驶往该国的航运路线。

sentences.en: Observers say this attack could prompt stricter security measures for vessels passing through the Gulf of Finland.
sentences.zh: 观察者表示，这次袭击可能促使通过芬兰湾的船只采取更严格的安全措施。

focus.meaning: 促使更严格的安全措施

quiz.q: Which country is believed to be behind the drone attack on the ship?
quiz.explainZh: 芬兰防卫部队认为乌克兰很可能实施了这次袭击。

articles.title: Ukraine President Calls Crimea Bridge Strikes a Fair Response
articles.titleZh: 乌克兰总统称克里米亚桥攻击是公平回应
articles.summaryZh: 乌克兰总统称，基辅在遭受109次俄方空袭后，对克里米亚桥发起攻击，认为这是合理的报复。

sentences.en: President Volodymyr Zelensky said the strikes on the Crimean Bridge were a fair response to Russia's attacks.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，对克里米亚桥的攻击是对俄罗斯袭击的公平回应。

focus.note: 用来形容行动的正当性

sentences.en: He met with UK Foreign Secretary James Cleverly to discuss the escalating tensions in the region.
sentences.zh: 他会见了英国外交大臣詹姆斯·克莱弗利，讨论该地区升级的紧张局势。

sentences.en: Zelensky cited 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on Ukrainian bridges as the trigger for his decision.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基提到俄方对乌克兰桥梁进行的109次空袭是他决定的触发点。

sentences.en: The Crimean Bridge connects Russia to Crimea, a territory that Ukraine says remains under illegal occupation.
sentences.zh: 克里米亚桥连接俄罗斯与克里米亚，乌克兰认为该领土仍处于非法占领之下。

sentences.en: The bridge is a key supply route for Russian troops and supplies heading to eastern Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 该桥是俄罗斯部队和补给前往乌克兰东部的重要供应路线。

sentences.en: Ukraine argues that the attacks are aimed at disrupting Russia's war effort and protecting civilians.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰认为这些袭击旨在破坏俄罗斯的战争努力并保护平民。

sentences.en: The UK has pledged support for Ukraine's right to defend itself against aggression.
sentences.zh: 英国已承诺支持乌克兰抵御侵略的权利。

sentences.en: International observers will watch for any further escalation or retaliation from either side.
sentences.zh: 国际观察者将关注双方是否进一步升级或报复。

sentences.en: The next few days will be crucial as both nations prepare for potential new military actions.
sentences.zh: 未来几天将至关重要，因为双方正准备可能的新军事行动。

focus.text: prepare for potential new military actions
focus.meaning: 准备可能的新军事行动

sentences.en: The global community is urging restraint, hoping to prevent a wider conflict in the region.
sentences.zh: 全球社会敦促克制，希望防止该地区更大范围的冲突。

quiz.q: How many Russian aerial attacks on Ukrainian bridges did Zelensky mention before the Crimean Bridge strikes?
quiz.explainZh: 泽连斯基提到的俄方空袭次数是109次。

quiz.q: Which UK official did Zelensky meet to discuss the situation?
quiz.explainZh: 他会见的是英国外交大臣詹姆斯·克莱弗利。
